**issue:** JSON.stringify on arbitrary objects can throw for circular structures; consider guarding against this.

In `extractFields`, a circular or very deep `record` object will cause `JSON.stringify` to throw and make `updateIndices` fail for the whole batch. Consider wrapping this in try/catch and either skipping that field or using a simpler fallback representation so one problematic value doesn’t block indexing for the rest of the batch.

**suggestion (testing):** Add tests for `updateIndices` ID stringification on delete and field selection when `resourceFields` is provided

Two behaviors still need coverage:
- For `operation: "delete"`, IDs are stringified. Please add a case with numeric IDs (e.g. `{ id: 1 }`) and assert `adapter.remove` receives `ids: ["1"]`.
- When `resourceFields` is provided, only those fields (excluding `id`) should be indexed. Add a case where the record has extra properties and assert `fields` only includes the specified resource fields (e.g. `title`) and omits others (e.g. `ignored`).

**Missing `adapter-contracts` package breaks installation** The dependency `"@searchfn/adapter-contracts": "file:../adapter-contracts"` points to `searchfn/adapter-contracts/`, but that directory does not exist anywhere in the repository. Running `npm install` (or any package manager install) in `searchfn/datafn-provider/` will fail because the local `file:` path cannot be resolved. Either the `adapter-contracts` package needs to be added to the repo as a sibling directory, or this should reference a published npm package (e.g. `"@searchfn/adapter-contracts": "^x.y.z"`) once it is published. As the PR stands, the package is uninstallable.

**Pervasive `as any` casts bypass TypeScript safety** Both `search` and `searchAll` immediately cast `params` to `any`, and the resulting adapter call objects are also cast with `as any`. While this may be needed because `@datafn/core`'s `SearchProvider` params don't expose `fuzzy`/`prefix`/`fieldBoosts` today, it silently removes all compile-time checks for the entire params object. Consider narrowing the cast to an intersection type rather than widening to `any`: ```ts // Instead of: const request = params as any; type ExtendedSearchParams = typeof params & { fuzzy?: boolean; prefix?: boolean; fieldBoosts?: Record; }; const request = params as ExtendedSearchParams; ``` This preserves safety for the fields that are already typed while allowing the extensions.

**`Promise.all` in fallback batches: one failed resource rejects the entire batch** In the fallback `searchAll` path, each batch of up to 10 resources is executed with `Promise.all`. If a single `adapter.search` call throws, the entire batch — and thus the whole `searchAll` call — rejects. If best-effort semantics are preferred, consider `Promise.allSettled`: ```ts const settled = await Promise.allSettled(batch.map(async (resource: string) => { ... })); const batchResults = settled .filter((r): r is PromiseFulfilledResult => r.status === "fulfilled") .flatMap((r) => r.value); ``` If fail-fast is intentional, a comment documenting that decision would help future readers.

`@searchfn/adapter-contracts` is declared as `file:../adapter-contracts`, but this commit does not add that directory under `searchfn/`, so the dependency cannot be resolved in this repo and `@searchfn/datafn-provider` cannot be installed or typechecked reliably. This also propagates a non-portable local path into published metadata, which can break consumer installs outside this monorepo. Please switch this to a real workspace/published version reference that resolves in CI and for external users.

**Add `searchfn/*` to root workspace configuration.**

The root `package.json` workspaces entry lists `"searchfn"` (matching only `searchfn/package.json`), but not `"searchfn/*"` for subdirectories. This means `searchfn/datafn-provider/` won't be discovered by workspace tooling (npm/yarn workspaces, Turbo), preventing it from being included in root-level build, test, and typecheck tasks.

Update the root `package.json` workspaces entry to include subdirectories:

```diff

    "searchfn",

    "botfn/*",
    "hostfn/*",
```
